issue: isAgentSetting is now case-sensitive: a writer commit that adds .CLAUDE/settings.json or claude.md passes the push guard, and on a case-insensitive file system (macOS, Windows) it is the same file claude loads (#110; ADR-0012 S12).
The test drops the other-letter-case paths (alsoYes) that would have caught the case-sensitive match, so the regression stays green.
